files.description: Full HTML of the ONC certification page, which contains the b(10) EHI export documentation as inline text (six bullet points describing export formats) and links to g(10) FHIR API docs. This is the primary source for EHI export documentation.
Full-page screenshot of the ONC certification disclosure page showing all sections including criteria list, FHIR g(10) links, b(10) EHI export text, CQMs, and RWT links.
Targeted screenshot of the 'Electronic Health Information export b(10)' section showing the six bullet points that constitute the entire EHI export documentation.

76-page FHIR API documentation for g(10) Standardized API. Covers SMART on FHIR launch, OAuth2 auth, and supported FHIR resources (Patient, AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, CareTeam, Condition, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Goal, Immunization, Medication, Observation, Procedure, Provenance). This is g(10) documentation, not b(10), but downloaded for context on what clinical data the FHIR API exposes vs what the EHI export covers.
Single-page PDF listing FHIR server endpoint URLs (test and production) for the g(10) API. Lists test FHIR server at fhirserver.braintreemd.com:9443 and production at btfhir.braintreemd.com:9443.

Cost disclosure spreadsheet (Excel-exported HTML frameset). Contains pricing/cost information per ONC transparency requirements. Not directly relevant to EHI export documentation but downloaded as it was the only other non-RWT document on the page.
